import json,os
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # vertical period from top content block: rows until the all-zero row
    zr=next(i for i in range(h) if all(c==0 for c in g[i]))
    p=zr  # rows 0..zr-1 are the block, period p
    for i in range(zr+1,h):
        g[i]=g[(i)%p][:] if i%p< p and (i-zr-1)>=0 else g[(i)%p][:]
    # simpler: below separator, tile rows 0..p-1 starting at row zr+1 -> row zr+1 = row0? 
    return g
# apply: rows 5..8 = rows 0..3
